scope: Belfry of Bruges, the brick market hall ranges around the open court and the square-facing entrance as recorded in 2005.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The tower is 83 meters high, leans one meter southeast and has a late-medieval octagonal upper level in Brabant sandstone.
The 83-meter belfry rises from the Market wing of the irregular enclosed brick hall, while the top carries an openwork parapet and pinnacles.
